_comment: The ONE manifest that exists, and it exists to prove the format against a real
provider rather than a guessed sponsor API. The browser family is 3B's, and it is
3A's first and only genuine consumer until the sponsor list lands.
Note what is NOT here: no credential value, no full JSON schema, no endpoint with
auth in it. schemaRef and credentialRef are pointers. This manifest is checked in.
NOTE ON DESTINATION: this manifest describes the LOCAL backend. Browserbase's
descriptors deliberately exclude local_only context and secret data, and they are
registered from code (browserDescriptors.ts) rather than here, so that rule is
encoded in the descriptor itself and cannot be edited away in a config file.

tools.description: Open a browser session, optionally at a starting URL.
Run a search and return the result text.
Extract text from the current page.
Return the indexed table of interactive elements on the page.
Click the element that best matches the goal.
Type a value into the field that best matches the goal.
Submit a form. Irreversible: always requires human approval.
